resources.string: Keidts, a fork of APK Explorer & Editor (AEE), an open-source tool to explore the contents of an installed APK, is strictly made with an aim to inspect installed APK\'s.
Keidts %s can be obtained from GitHub: https://github.com/malwar77/keidts

Welcome to Keidts, a powerful tool to explore the contents of an installed APK!

Important
Keidts is strictly made with good intentions. Please do not use this tool for any kind of illegal or inappropriate activities.
